entry.title: Groove Dice 1.9.0
entry.summary: # Groove Dice 1.9.0 MAIN and PERFORM now have independent Dice and Undo. entry.title: Groove Dice 1.8.0
entry.summary: # Groove Dice 1.8.0 - Musical snare rolls use short rhythmic motifs, rests, beat accents, restrained grace notes and shaped endings. Generated fills retain the main kick motif and 2/4 snare anchors, adding sparse replies. - Four finite hat rolls join four snare rolls and four fills on PERFORM. B1–B4: snare; B5–B8: fill; B9–B12: hats; B13: loop; B14: stop.
